en: The County of Ribagorza as a medieval county on the southern side of the central Pyrenees
Its position between Aragon, Navarre and the Catalan counties
zh: 里瓦戈萨伯国是比利牛斯山脉中段南侧的中世纪伯国
位于阿拉贡、纳瓦拉与加泰罗尼亚诸伯国之间

politics.zh: 里瓦戈萨伯国是比利牛斯山脉中段南侧的中世纪伯国，位于阿拉贡、纳瓦拉与加泰罗尼亚诸伯国之间，以今韦斯卡省北部为中心。它形成于9至10世纪，由本地伯爵家族统治，先后被纳瓦拉与阿拉贡的王朝争夺，11世纪后并入阿拉贡王国，此后长期作为王室成员的封地存在，15世纪后逐渐失去政治意义。
politics.en: The County of Ribagorza was a medieval county on the southern side of the central Pyrenees, lying between Aragon, Navarre and the Catalan counties and centred on what is now northern Huesca province. It took shape in the ninth and tenth centuries under local comital families and was contested by the crowns of Navarre and Aragon, passing into the kingdom of Aragon after the eleventh century, where it long survived as an appanage for members of the royal house before losing political significance after the fifteenth century.

economy.zh: 经济以比利牛斯山地的畜牧、谷地农业与木材利用为基础，埃塞拉河与辛卡河流域的灌溉农业支撑定居村落，牲畜与羊毛贸易连接山南的埃布罗河谷市场。
economy.en: The economy rested on herding in the Pyrenean valleys, farming on the lower slopes and the use of timber, with irrigation along the Esera and Cinca rivers supporting settled villages, and livestock and wool linking the mountain communities to the markets of the Ebro valley to the south.

culture.zh: 伯国位于巴斯克、阿拉贡与加泰罗尼亚文化交界，罗马式教堂与修道院散布山谷，本地罗曼语方言与拉丁文书并存，口头传统与圣徒崇拜构成乡村文化基础。
culture.en: The county lay where Basque, Aragonese and Catalan cultural areas met, its Romanesque churches and monasteries are scattered through the valleys, local Romance speech existed alongside Latin documents, and oral tradition and the veneration of saints formed the basis of rural culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9至10世纪伯国形成、11世纪被纳瓦拉与阿拉贡争夺、此后并入阿拉贡王国，以及15世纪后逐渐失去政治意义。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the county in the ninth and tenth centuries, the contest between Navarre and Aragon in the eleventh, its absorption into the kingdom of Aragon and its gradual loss of political significance after the fifteenth century.

value.zh: 位于比利牛斯山脉中段南侧，今韦斯卡省北部。
value.en: It lay on the southern side of the central Pyrenees, in what is now northern Huesca.
It passed into the kingdom of Aragon after the eleventh century.

en: The Kingdom of Bithynia as a Hellenistic kingdom centred in the historical region of Bithynia in north-west Anatolia
Its establishment and its position between the Greek cities of the coast and the Anatolian interior
zh: 比提尼亚王国是位于安纳托利亚西北部历史地区比提尼亚的希腊化王国
地处沿海希腊城市与安纳托利亚内陆之间

politics.zh: 比提尼亚王国是位于安纳托利亚西北部历史地区比提尼亚的希腊化王国，地处沿海希腊城市与安纳托利亚内陆之间，由本地王统统治。它在公元前3至前2世纪与塞琉古、帕加马及罗马周旋，尼科美德斯四世去世后于公元前74年将王国遗赠罗马，此后成为罗马行省，是罗马进入小亚细亚的重要跳板。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Bithynia was a Hellenistic kingdom centred in the historical region of Bithynia in north-west Anatolia, lying between the Greek cities of the coast and the Anatolian interior and ruled by a local royal line. Through the third and second centuries BC it manoeuvred among the Seleucids, Pergamon and Rome, and on the death of Nicomedes IV in 74 BC it was bequeathed to Rome, becoming a province and an important bridgehead for Roman power in Asia Minor.

economy.zh: 经济以黑海与马尔马拉海沿岸的港口贸易、农业与林业为基础，比提尼亚的港口连接希腊世界与黑海航道，木材、谷物与奴隶是重要交换物，道路与驿站网络便利过境运输。
economy.en: The economy rested on port trade along the Black Sea and the Sea of Marmara together with farming and forestry, its harbours linking the Greek world with the sea routes of the Black Sea, with timber, grain and slaves as important goods of exchange, and roads and posting stations easing transit traffic.

culture.zh: 比提尼亚的希腊城市与本地色雷斯-弗里吉亚传统并存，希腊语为行政与城市生活语言，神庙与剧场见于城市，铭文与钱币记录了王统与地方制度。
culture.en: The Greek cities of Bithynia existed alongside local Thracian and Phrygian traditions, Greek served administration and city life, temples and theatres stood in its towns, and inscriptions and coins record its royal line and local institutions.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前3世纪王国形成、与塞琉古及帕加马的关系、公元前74年尼科美德斯四世遗赠罗马，以及此后成为罗马行省。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the kingdom in the third century BC, its relations with the Seleucids and Pergamon, the bequest of Nicomedes IV to Rome in 74 BC and its transformation into a Roman province afterwards.

value.zh: 公元前74年由尼科美德斯四世遗赠罗马。
value.en: Nicomedes IV bequeathed it to Rome in 74 BC.

value.zh: 位于安纳托利亚西北部比提尼亚地区。
value.en: It lay in the Bithynia region of north-west Anatolia.

en: The Karamanids, also known as the Emirate or Beylik of Karaman, as a Turkish Anatolian principality
Its rule over the Karaman region and its rivalry with the rising Ottoman state
zh: 卡拉曼公国又称卡拉曼埃米尔国，是安纳托利亚的突厥公国
统治卡拉曼地区，与兴起的奥斯曼国家长期对抗

politics.zh: 卡拉曼公国又称卡拉曼埃米尔国，是安纳托利亚的突厥公国，由卡拉曼家族统治，以科尼亚与卡拉曼为中心，13世纪末在蒙古压力下于安纳托利亚中部兴起。它自视为塞尔柱苏丹国的继承者，与奥斯曼国家长期争夺安纳托利亚霸权，并与其他贝伊国结盟对抗；1467年前后被奥斯曼帝国吞并，其地成为奥斯曼的行省。
politics.en: The Karamanids, also known as the Emirate or Beylik of Karaman, were a Turkish principality in Anatolia ruled by the Karaman family and centred on Konya and Karaman, which emerged in central Anatolia at the end of the thirteenth century under Mongol pressure. Regarding themselves as heirs of the Seljuk sultanate, they contested the hegemony of Anatolia with the rising Ottoman state for generations and allied with other beyliks against it; around 1467 the Ottomans annexed their lands and made them a province.

economy.zh: 经济以安纳托利亚中部的农业、畜牧与城镇手工业为基础，科尼亚是商路交汇的market城镇，谷物、牲畜与纺织品在集市中流通，商队客栈沿主要道路分布。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, herding and urban crafts in central Anatolia, with Konya a market town at the meeting of trade routes, grain, livestock and textiles changing hands in its bazaars, and caravanserais standing along the main roads.

culture.zh: 卡拉曼公国以突厥语为宫廷与文学语言，是安纳托利亚早期突厥语文学的重要中心，伊斯兰学校与苏菲道堂活跃，波斯与突厥文化传统在此交汇。
culture.en: The Karamanids used Turkish at court and in literature and were an important early centre of Turkish writing in Anatolia, their religious schools and Sufi lodges were active, and Persian and Turkish cultural traditions met there.

events.zh: 关键节点包括13世纪末公国兴起、14世纪与奥斯曼的长期战争、15世纪中期的内部纷争，以及1467年前后被奥斯曼吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the rise of the principality at the end of the thirteenth century, the long wars with the Ottomans in the fourteenth, internal conflict in the mid-fifteenth century and its annexation by the Ottomans around 1467.

value.zh: 以科尼亚与卡拉曼为中心。
value.en: It was centred on Konya and Karaman.

en: Dal Riata as a Gaelic kingdom encompassing the western seaboard of Scotland and north-eastern Ireland on each side of the North Channel
Its role in the spread of Gaelic language and culture to what became Scotland
zh: 达尔里阿达是盖尔人王国，领有苏格兰西海岸与爱尔兰东北部，横跨北海峡两岸
在盖尔语言与文化向苏格兰传播中起关键作用

politics.zh: 达尔里阿达是盖尔人王国，领有苏格兰西海岸与爱尔兰东北部，横跨北海峡两岸，以邓纳德与邓斯塔夫内奇等要塞为中心。它存在于6至9世纪，由达尔里阿达王统统治，与皮克特人、不列颠人及诺森布里亚长期互动；9世纪中叶并入阿尔巴王统，成为苏格兰王国形成的重要一环。
politics.en: Dal Riata was a Gaelic kingdom that encompassed the western seaboard of Scotland and north-eastern Ireland on each side of the North Channel, centred on strongholds such as Dunadd and Dunstaffnage. It existed from the sixth to the ninth century under its own royal line and interacted for generations with the Picts, the Britons and Northumbria; in the mid-ninth century its kings were absorbed into the emerging kingdom of Alba, making it a key element in the formation of Scotland.

economy.zh: 经济以海路贸易、渔业、畜牧与少量农业为基础，群岛与海湾是航运与渔猎的中心，与爱尔兰、不列颠及欧洲大陆的海上联系带来交换与移民。
economy.en: The economy rested on sea trade, fishing, herding and limited farming, its islands and sea lochs being centres of shipping and fishing, and maritime links with Ireland, Britain and continental Europe bringing exchange and migration.

culture.zh: 达尔里阿达是盖尔文化向苏格兰传播的桥梁，盖尔语与爱尔兰式修道制度在此扎根，爱奥那岛的修道院是学术与传教中心，石雕十字与要塞遗址留下遗存。
culture.en: Dal Riata was the bridge by which Gaelic culture spread into Scotland, Gaelic speech and Irish monastic institutions took root there, the monastery of Iona was a centre of learning and mission, and carved crosses and hillforts survive as its remains.

events.zh: 关键节点包括6世纪王国形成、与皮克特及诺森布里亚的战争、9世纪中叶并入阿尔巴王统，以及此后盖尔文化在苏格兰的扩展。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the kingdom in the sixth century, the wars with the Picts and Northumbria, the absorption of its kings into the Alba dynasty in the mid-ninth century and the later spread of Gaelic culture through Scotland.

value.zh: 横跨北海峡，领有苏格兰西海岸与爱尔兰东北部。
value.en: It spanned the North Channel, covering western Scotland and north-eastern Ireland.

value.zh: 以邓纳德等要塞为中心。
value.en: It was centred on strongholds such as Dunadd.

en: Turkey, officially the Republic of Turkiye, as a country mainly located in Anatolia in West Asia with a smaller part in East Thrace in South-East Europe
Its borders with the Black Sea, Georgia, Armenia, Iran, Iraq, Syria, the Mediterranean, Greece and Bulgaria
zh: 土耳其正式称土耳其共和国，主体位于西亚安纳托利亚，另有东色雷斯部分位于东南欧
濒临黑海与地中海，邻格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚、伊朗、伊拉克、叙利亚、希腊与保加利亚

politics.zh: 土耳其共和国主体位于西亚安纳托利亚，另有东色雷斯部分位于东南欧，濒临黑海与地中海，邻格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚、伊朗、伊拉克、叙利亚、希腊与保加利亚，首都为安卡拉。1923年奥斯曼帝国解体后建立共和国，实行世俗化与现代化改革；二战后实行多党制，1980年后经历军人干预与经济自由化，现为总统制共和国。
politics.en: Turkey, officially the Republic of Turkiye, is a country mainly located in Anatolia in West Asia, with a smaller part called East Thrace in South-East Europe, bordered by the Black Sea, Georgia, Armenia, Iran, Iraq, Syria, the Mediterranean, Greece and Bulgaria, with Ankara as its capital. The republic was founded in 1923 after the dissolution of the Ottoman empire and carried out secularising and modernising reforms; after the Second World War it adopted multi-party politics, went through military interventions and economic liberalisation after 1980 and is now a presidential republic.

economy.zh: 经济以制造业、农业、建筑业与旅游业为基础，纺织、汽车、家电与食品加工是重要产业，博斯普鲁斯与达达尼尔海峡是能源与货运通道，地区发展差距与通胀是长期问题。
economy.en: The economy rests on manufacturing, agriculture, construction and tourism, with textiles, vehicles, appliances and food processing among the leading industries, the Bosphorus and Dardanelles serving as energy and freight corridors, and regional development gaps and inflation remaining long-term problems.

culture.zh: 土耳其文化融合突厥、奥斯曼、伊斯兰与地中海传统，土耳其语为官方语言，文学、音乐与饮食影响广泛，清真寺、宫殿与考古遗址构成丰富的文化遗产。
culture.en: Turkish culture combines Turkic, Ottoman, Islamic and Mediterranean traditions, Turkish is the official language, its literature, music and cuisine have wide influence, and its mosques, palaces and archaeological sites form a rich heritage. Its tea houses and bazaars are part of everyday urban life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1923年建立共和国、此后的世俗化改革、1950年转向多党选举、1980年军人干预，以及2017年改为总统制。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the republic in 1923, the secularising reforms that followed, the shift to multi-party elections in 1950, the military intervention of 1980 and the change to a presidential system in 2017.

value.zh: 1923年奥斯曼帝国解体后建立共和国。
value.en: The republic was founded in 1923 after the dissolution of the Ottoman empire.

en: The Republic of Ragusa as an aristocratic maritime republic centred on the city of Dubrovnik in South Dalmatia
Its long survival through tribute and diplomacy between larger powers
zh: 拉古萨共和国是以南达尔马提亚杜布罗夫尼克城为中心的贵族制海洋共和国
靠纳贡与外交在列强之间长期存续

politics.zh: 拉古萨共和国是以南达尔马提亚杜布罗夫尼克城为中心的贵族制海洋共和国，由贵族家族组成的议会与元老院治理，15世纪起设督治一职。它先后向匈牙利、奥斯曼与威尼斯纳贡以换取自治与贸易自由，凭借商船队与外交网络在地中海与巴尔干之间长期存续，1808年被拿破仑的法国军队废止。
politics.en: The Republic of Ragusa was an aristocratic maritime republic centred on the city of Dubrovnik in South Dalmatia, governed by councils and a senate of noble families with a rector at its head from the fifteenth century. It paid tribute in turn to Hungary, the Ottoman empire and Venice in exchange for autonomy and freedom of trade, and its merchant fleet and diplomatic network allowed it to survive for centuries between the Mediterranean and the Balkans, until Napoleon's forces abolished it in 1808.

economy.zh: 经济以海运贸易、造船与信贷为基础，商船队远航至地中海、黑海与北欧港口，食盐、金属、布匹与香料是主要货品，领事网络与保险制度支撑海外经营。
economy.en: The economy rested on maritime trade, shipbuilding and credit, its merchant fleet sailing to ports across the Mediterranean, the Black Sea and northern Europe, with salt, metals, cloth and spices as the main cargoes and a network of consuls and insurance arrangements supporting business abroad.

culture.zh: 拉古萨以拉丁语、意大利语与克罗地亚语并用，文艺复兴时期的文学与科学成就突出，城墙与宫殿等建筑遗存被列为世界遗产，天主教机构与兄弟会塑造城市生活。
culture.en: Latin, Italian and Croatian were all used in Ragusa, its Renaissance literature and science were notable, its walls and palaces are a World Heritage site, and Catholic institutions and confraternities shaped city life. Its summer festival draws performers from across Europe.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14世纪取得自治、15至16世纪的海运鼎盛、1667年大地震后的重建，以及1808年被法国废止。
events.en: Key moments are the attainment of autonomy in the fourteenth century, the height of its shipping in the fifteenth and sixteenth, the rebuilding after the great earthquake of 1667 and its abolition by the French in 1808.

value.zh: 以杜布罗夫尼克城为中心。
value.en: It was centred on the city of Dubrovnik.

value.zh: 1808年被拿破仑的法国军队废止。
value.en: Napoleon's French forces abolished it in 1808.

en: The Duchy of Naples as a Byzantine province in Southern Europe constituted in the seventh century
Its gradual transformation into an independent duchy under local dukes
zh: 那不勒斯公国是7世纪设立的拜占庭南欧省份
后逐渐演变为由本地公爵统治的独立公国

politics.zh: 那不勒斯公国是7世纪设立的拜占庭南欧省份，最初由拜占庭任命的长官治理，8世纪后逐渐演变为由本地公爵家族世袭统治的独立公国。它夹在拜占庭、教皇国、伦巴第诸侯与后来的西西里王国之间，靠外交与海防维持自主，1137年前后被诺曼人并入西西里王国。
politics.en: The Duchy of Naples began as a Byzantine province in Southern Europe that was constituted in the seventh century, at first governed by officials appointed from Constantinople and from the eighth century gradually becoming an independent duchy under local ducal families. Lying between Byzantium, the papal states, the Lombard principalities and later the kingdom of Sicily, it preserved its autonomy through diplomacy and coastal defence until the Normans absorbed it into the kingdom of Sicily around 1137.

economy.zh: 经济以那不勒斯湾的港口贸易、农业与渔业为基础，城市与君士坦丁堡、阿马尔菲及北非港口保持往来，谷物、布匹与奢侈品是主要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on port trade in the bay of Naples together with farming and fishing, the city maintaining links with Constantinople, Amalfi and the ports of North Africa, and grain, cloth and luxury goods forming the main objects of exchange.

culture.zh: 那不勒斯公国保留希腊与拉丁双重传统，修道士与抄本在此流传，早期教堂与地下墓窟留下遗存，城市自治机构与教会共同管理地方事务。
culture.en: The duchy preserved both Greek and Latin traditions, monks and manuscripts circulated there, early churches and catacombs survive as remains, and civic bodies shared the management of local affairs with the church. Its Greek monasteries kept links with southern Italy for centuries.

events.zh: 关键节点包括7世纪设省、8世纪后公爵家族世袭、与拜占庭及教皇国的关系，以及1137年前后被诺曼人并入西西里王国。
events.en: Key moments are the creation of the province in the seventh century, the hereditary rule of ducal families after the eighth, its relations with Byzantium and the papacy and its absorption by the Normans into the kingdom of Sicily around 1137.

value.en: It was constituted by Byzantium in the seventh century.

value.zh: 1137年前后被诺曼人并入西西里王国。
value.en: The Normans absorbed it into the kingdom of Sicily around 1137.

en: The Kingdom of Croatia, and from 1060 the Kingdom of Croatia and Dalmatia, as a medieval kingdom in the western Balkans
Its union with Hungary from 1102 and its long association with the Hungarian crown
zh: 克罗地亚王国自1060年起称克罗地亚与达尔马提亚王国，是西巴尔干的中世纪王国
1102年与匈牙利联合，此后长期与匈牙利王权关联

politics.zh: 克罗地亚王国自1060年起称克罗地亚与达尔马提亚王国，是西巴尔干的中世纪王国，由特皮米罗维奇与后来的本地王统统治，以比奥格勒、克宁等地为中心。它控制亚得里亚海东岸城市与内陆地区，与威尼斯、拜占庭和匈牙利长期互动；1102年与匈牙利结成共主联合，此后克罗地亚保持自己的议会、法律与地方贵族制度。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Croatia, known from 1060 as the Kingdom of Croatia and Dalmatia, was a medieval kingdom in the western Balkans ruled by the Trpimirovic line and later local dynasties from centres such as Biograd and Knin. It controlled the cities of the eastern Adriatic coast and the interior and interacted for centuries with Venice, Byzantium and Hungary; in 1102 it entered a personal union with Hungary, after which Croatia kept its own diet, law and local nobility.

economy.zh: 经济以亚得里亚海沿岸的城市贸易、内地的农业与畜牧为基础，扎达尔、斯普利特等港口连接地中海商路，木材、盐、牲畜与布匹是重要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on the trade of the Adriatic coastal cities and on farming and herding inland, with ports such as Zadar and Split linked to Mediterranean routes and timber, salt, livestock and cloth among the goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 克罗地亚王国处于拉丁基督教与拜占庭文化之间，格拉哥里字母与拉丁字母并用，石造教堂与修道院留下遗存，地方贵族与教会共同维护语言与法律传统。
culture.en: The kingdom lay between Latin Christianity and Byzantine culture, the Glagolitic and Latin scripts were both used, stone churches and monasteries survive as remains, and local nobles and the church together maintained language and legal tradition.

events.zh: 关键节点包括925年前后王国建立、1060年起并称克罗地亚与达尔马提亚、1102年与匈牙利联合，以及此后在匈牙利王权下的自治延续。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the kingdom around 925, its renaming as Croatia and Dalmatia from 1060, the personal union with Hungary in 1102 and the continuation of its autonomy under the Hungarian crown afterwards.

value.en: It entered a personal union with Hungary in 1102.

value.zh: 此后保留自己的议会与法律。
value.en: It kept its own diet and law afterwards.
